Meaningful Holiday#000.src: So, how is it going? Did you find Nick in the slum?
Meaningful Holiday#000.dst: E aí, como vai? Achou o Nick no cortiço?

Meaningful Holiday#001.src: You should follow Nick and hop in the portal right there!
Meaningful Holiday#001.dst: Você devia seguir o Nick e pular naquele portal ali!

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I can't wait for the feast to be served. It's always magnificent.
Meaningful Holiday#002.dst: Mal posso esperar pelo banquete. É sempre magnífico.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: You want me to donate food? I'm just a guest here.
Meaningful Holiday#003.dst: Quer que eu doe comida? Sou só um convidado aqui.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: You want food for the poor? They should get jobs and help themselves!
Meaningful Holiday#004.dst: Quer comida para os pobres? Que arranjem emprego e se virem!

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Why should I help them if they don't help themselves?
Meaningful Holiday#005.dst: Por que eu ajudaria quem não se ajuda?

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: I can't give away free food! This is the biggest feast of the year!
Meaningful Holiday#006.dst: Não posso dar comida de graça! É o maior banquete do ano!

Meaningful Holiday#007.src: You should go and ask charities for that.
Meaningful Holiday#007.dst: Peça isso às instituições de caridade.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#008.dst: Se quer ajudar alguém este ano, nosso chefe Nick já está na linha de frente.
Meaningful Holiday#008.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#010.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.dst: Foi mal, mas tá tudo vendido, todo mundo se arrumando pro Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#011.dst: Talvez tenha algo no sótão, se achar alguma coisa, pode ficar. Sei como a coisa aperta.
Meaningful Holiday#011.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.
Meaningful Holiday#013.dst: Parece que tô sem comida. Mal dá pra eu mesmo comer.
Meaningful Holiday#013.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#014.dst: Ah, e pode dar este cobertor para a Margaret quando passar pelo túnel? É só seguir a estrada atrás de mim.
Meaningful Holiday#014.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#016.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#016.dst: Ah, por favor, não me mande embora. Não tenho para onde ir!
Meaningful Holiday#016.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: Oi! Acabei de enfeitar esta árvore de Craftmas!
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: Roubar não é o espírito do Craftmas… Mas acho que dá para aproveitar.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: Meus irmãos e eu cuidamos do povo no Craftmas. Minha área é o deserto de {p}. Pode me chamar de Papai Noel das Dunas, he.
Meaningful Holiday#021.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: Olá, querido. Sou a Haily. Prazer em conhecer.
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: Este é o centro de caridade de {p}. Buscamos voluntários para ajudar os sem-teto este ano.
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: Ele é um homem muito especial. Vou anotar onde ele está no seu livro. Ah, lembre que é caridade, então espero que a gratidão baste como recompensa.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: Vá falar com Nick, amigo de Haily, na área pobre.

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: Oh. Oh… Ai, ai. Tem mais gente aqui do que nunca.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: Hm, está só de passagem? Oh! Um voluntário!
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: Você é o único este ano. As coisas mudaram mesmo. Antes tínhamos centenas de voluntários nesta época.
Meaningful Holiday#029.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#030.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#030.dst: O povo aqui passa fome. Não há outro jeito de dizer.
Meaningful Holiday#030.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#031.dst: Não sei como vamos alimentar todo mundo este ano.
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#032.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#032.dst: O dono da loja barata já foi sem-teto… Ele sabe o que eles passam.
Meaningful Holiday#032.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: Eu cuido das coisas aqui. Pode ir à loja barata? É bem perto. Qualquer comida é bem-vinda.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: Vá à loja barata e peça comida.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#039.dst: Hm… Esta maçã já viu dias melhores…
Meaningful Holiday#039.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#040.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#040.dst: Queria ter algo para dar este ano. Acho que o povo da cidade está num banquete.
Meaningful Holiday#040.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#041.dst: Volte ao Nick e dê a má notícia.

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#044.dst: Não posso ficar chateado. Ele doa tanto no resto do ano.
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: Talvez tenhamos de pedir aos fazendeiros…
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: Conheço alguém em {p} de bom coração.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: Já brigamos antes, parece que ele não entendeu o que é doação.
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Há um atalho ao sul daqui, numa caverna. Passe por lá.
Meaningful Holiday#048.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: Leve o cobertor à mulher no túnel ao sul de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: Oh, um cobertor para mim? Que gentil… Do Nick, é? Ele é sempre tão bondoso… Obrigada também.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: Se quiser chegar rápido a {p}, siga por este túnel. Alguns sem-teto nada amigáveis vivem por aqui, então cuidado. É tão triste ver como estão.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: Siga pelo túnel e encontre o amigo de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: Bem-vindo à fazenda! Quer comprar colheitas frescas?
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: Bom, parece que deu azar. Acabei de vender o resto desta colheita.
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: Foi tudo para aquele grande banquete de Craftmas em {p}. Queria ajudar, mas não tenho mais comida para vender.
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: Espere, aposto que o Nick te mandou, né? Olha, ele vem pela esquerda. Lembre a ele que isto não é caridade.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: Nenhuma comida? Estamos ficando sem opções…
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: Bem, nesta época só resta uma pessoa a quem apelar.
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: Explore a área e procure o Papai Noel.

Meaningful Holiday#063.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#063.dst: Ele está descendo a escada, à direita.
Meaningful Holiday#063.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#064.dst: Entre na casa do Papai Noel e fale com ele.

Meaningful Holiday#066.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#066.dst: Cada membro do conselho cuida de uma área. A sua é {p}. Como cuida dela é sua responsabilidade.
Meaningful Holiday#066.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: Há cinco vezes mais sem-teto e famintos que ano passado!
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: Nick, sei que lá está difícil, mas-
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Difícil?! Está impossível! Cadê a boa vontade do povo? Tive um voluntário este ano! UM!
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: Sinto muito, Nick. Vá a {p} pedir lá, eles têm um banquete que alimentaria um exército!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: Hmmm… Ah, perdão. Calculei mal sua viagem até aqui. Bom te ver.
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: Imagino que ouviu o Papai Noel e eu. Vamos para {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Certo, está resolvido. Saia pela lareira atrás de mim, ela te leva direto a {p}. Boa sorte, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: Saia pelo portal atrás do Papai Noel.

Meaningful Holiday#076.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#076.dst: Uau. Esse povo vive no luxo. Será que sabem que no leste há gente passando fome?
Meaningful Holiday#076.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: E, mais importante, tomara que dividam um pouco de comida.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: Nem estão em traje de gala.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#084.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#084.dst: Comida? Querem comida? Isto parece caridade para vocês?
Meaningful Holiday#084.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#085.dst: Claro que não! Devemos alimentar nossos convidados, não uns pobres coitados do deserto!
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: Agora saiam antes que eu chame os golens de segurança. E nem pensem em roubar da cozinha!
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: Roube a comida da cozinha e fale com Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#088.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#089.dst: Conseguiu?! Não esperava tanta generosidade, uma caixa inteira?
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#092.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#092.dst: Vá na frente. Tenho um plano. Calma, vou devolver toda esta comida.
Meaningful Holiday#092.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#095.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#095.dst: Sei que têm fome. Eu também.
Meaningful Holiday#095.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#096.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#096.dst: Mas o jantar não será servido hoje.
Meaningful Holiday#096.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: Não haverá banquete de Craftmas este ano!
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#099.dst: A comida da mesa não dá para todos aqui!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#100.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#100.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: É assim que milhares vivem todo dia.
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: Com fome, sem saber quando haverá comida.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: E enquanto estão aí de estômago vazio, agradeçam o que têm. Pensem em quem não tem nada.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: Centenas de homens, mulheres e crianças, como vocês, não vão comer nada hoje.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: Tudo porque este enorme banquete não bastava. {p} comprou toda a comida, barata ou cara.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: Vim lembrar o verdadeiro sentido deste dia. Pensar nos outros..
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: Vou devolver o jantar de vocês, mas enquanto comem… quero que lembrem de cada boca vazia que ele poderia alimentar.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: Dividam o que têm, agradeçam o que recebem.
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: Bem, parece que você conseguiu de novo, Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: Vim ver se podia ajudar. Mas parece que você já resolveu.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#111.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#111.dst: Bem, acho que só falta uma coisa para completar a cena.
Meaningful Holiday#111.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#112.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: Parece que meu discursinho trouxe os ricos de volta à terra.
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#115.dst: Deram metade do banquete. Acredita que ainda sobrou?
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#116.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#116.dst: Toda aquela comida, direto pro lixo.
Meaningful Holiday#116.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: Não fazem ideia do que têm, comparados a essa gente pobre.
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: Quer saber como conheço o Papai Noel? Ele é meu irmão.
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: É gente como você que mantém vivo o verdadeiro sentido desta data. A cada ano fica mais difícil, com o sentido distorcido. Aqui, um presente meu. Obrigado.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick
